scope: The111 source-ledger-bound guide/discussion routes, evaluated against canonical delivered OGG descriptors and their delivery-media-seconds sidecars. Accepted canonical predicates are NOT executable-original/native-MP3 playback or highlight passes. In particular the d631 mapping explicitly excludes the native MP3 clock. Native MP3 source words are not qualified by copying/renaming delivery sidecars. Derived resource subroutes are separate; whole-file native derivatives and term descriptions gain no word qualification here. No media fetch, native playback, acoustic accuracy, physical-device acceptance or current production storage query; repository sidecar absence does not establish publisher absence. Since 2026-11-09 (captain: highlight the closest match everywhere) an accepted route carries its timing tier: exact (map unchanged), clamped (words fitted to the runtime clip or zero-duration words re-spaced) or approximate (under the 70 % heard-token floor; layout between heard anchors is interpolated). A tier is a disposition, not an acoustic acceptance.
